Rules.Name: EnterpriseAI-LiteLLM-Inbound-Block-NonLoopback
Rules.Description: Block non-loopback inbound to LiteLLM. Loopback binding is the primary protection; this rule adds defense-in-depth.
Rules.Note: Windows Firewall may not enforce per-process loopback rules in all configurations. See INTENT.md section 11.

Rules.Name: EnterpriseAI-Ollama-Inbound-Block-NonLoopback
Rules.Description: Block non-loopback inbound to Ollama backend. Users should not connect to Ollama directly.
Rules.Note: Windows Firewall may not enforce per-process loopback rules in all configurations. Validation produces WARN not FAIL for loopback isolation checks. See INTENT.md section 11.

Rules.Name: EnterpriseAI-Ollama-Inbound-Allow-Loopback
Rules.Description: Allow loopback inbound to Ollama from LiteLLM backend

Rules.Name: EnterpriseAI-Ollama-Outbound-Block-Internet
Rules.Description: Block Ollama outbound to Internet to prevent arbitrary model pulls. RuntimeModelPullsEnabled must be false (default).
Rules.Note: This rule is broad. When RuntimeModelPullsEnabled is true, the approved registry URL must be permitted instead.

Note: Rules with Action=Block for TCP 4000/11434 inbound provide defense-in-depth. The primary isolation mechanism is the loopback-only binding (127.0.0.1 and 127.0.0.2). Windows Firewall limitations are documented in INTENT.md.
